tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i zur mig gis// 'khor 'das snying gi mdza' na bo// dbang byed bla ma bcom ldan mas// tshul 'di 'dri la gnang ba stsol// 'di bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong nyid dbyings las dur khrod dbus// rab dmar pad nyi'i gdan la hrīḥ// de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// slar 'dus gcig tu gyur las bdag /ku ru kul+le byi ru'i mdog /lang tsho gzhon zhing mche zur gtsigs// spyan gsum g.yon phyogs zur mda' 'phen// phyag bzhi'i dang pos ut+pa la'i// mda' dang gzhu sbyar rna drung bkang*// tha gnyis dbang gi lcags kyu dang*// ut+pal dmar po'i zhags pa 'dzin// skra ser mgo bo'i phreng dag dang*// rus rgyan stag gi sham bu dkris// g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar// dmar ser ro yi snying gar brdzis// 'od zer dmar po phreng 'khrigs pa'i// gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ// sa bon 'od 'phros lho phyogs kyi// rigs byed phug nas rang 'dra dang*// 'phags tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrigs lnga yang*// 'dir byon bdag la dbang bskur stsol// de yis oṃ badz+rī bha wa// a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs// chu yis dbang bskur dri ma dag /spyi bor 'od dpag med pas brgyan// zhes brjod cing bsam mo// de nas snying ga nas spel ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod// yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spang*// sgra dang yi ge sems kyang med// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid// ces pas bstod do// nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ gyis chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang*// āḥlas thod pa ches yangs par// hūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// hoḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid 'bru gsum brjod cing myong ngo*// bzlas pa bya ba ni/

snying ga'i nyi mar hrīḥdang sngags// bkod pa'i 'od kyis skye 'phags kyi// yon tan tshe dpal bsod nams sogs// 'od dmar lam mer rang la thim// zhes brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba ming med kyi steng bgrangs la ci nus bzlas mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ yid 'phrog rigs byed dpa' mo yis// skye 'gro'i snying gi brtan pa dag /rang dbang phrogs nas srid zhi'i dpal// phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol// zhes pas 'dod don gsol/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa man ngag ltar nyams su blangs la/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// bdag med gzhan yang yod pa min// zhes sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid dang*/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa dang bral ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang tsam dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag thun las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rigs byed lha mo 'grub gyur nas// khams gsum 'gro ba dbang sdud cing*// sangs rgyas sa la bzhag par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngos la lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam la 'jug go /sbyin ma'i bu las ma phrogs shing*// gdengs can grong yang bsrubs min par// bdud rtsi'i mchog 'di 'thung ba'i rigs// skyes de skal ba mi dman grang*// he ru ka dpal sa skya pa'i// thugs ka dpal gyi be'u las// 'phos don tshigs su bcad byas pa'i// dge bas 'gro la phan gyur cig /ces lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang*/ kun dga' bsam gtan gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dag par gyur cig dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// mtha' yas rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum// pad+ma rā ga'i 'khri shing ltar// mtshar sdug mig gi dpyid la 'dud// gang gi mkhyen brtse'i lcags kyu yis// srid zhi'i snod bcud ma lus pa'i// dpal 'byor phun tshogs dbang sdud lha// rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// mdzes sku bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pas// rnam 'byed blo gros rgyas pa dang*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor kun 'du zhing*// skye 'gro dbang sdud dngos grub stsol// ces rigs byed dpa' mo la bsngags pa 'dod don kun ster zhes bya ba 'di ni sa skyong dpal mo dbyangs can ma yi bkas bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ma nor rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang gi thugs rje'i mig zur lhung tsam gyis// blo gros snang ba mi zad dga' ston mkhan// bla ma dbyangs kyi rgyal mor gus btud de// de yi sgrub thabs ma nor rab gsal 'dri// de la 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pas ji ltar nyams su bstar ba'i tshul ni/ skyabs 'gro spyi ltar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas ye shes kyi snang ba dgod par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du doḥyig dmar po las pad+ma dmar po doḥyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje dbyangs can ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ phyag g.yas gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon gsum na 'khor lo/ rin po che/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar mdzes pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba la doḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa gong ltar spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i doḥyig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dang grub pa ma lus pa'i yon tan dang shes rab dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ gzungs la sogs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim pas/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla'o// thun bsdu ba na/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ gdan 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dbyangs can lha mo 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo ba smon lam gang shes bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs par/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsams la/ spro na mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang sogs nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs gong ltar bskyed/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drangs la/ oṃ sā ra swasti oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ mtshan sngags de sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/

rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho sogs kyis bstod cing 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med na mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim par bsams la/ gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs gong ltar bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs pas gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni nges pa'o// dri med rgyud kyis legs bstan sgrub pa'i thabs// rgya bod mkhas pa'i bzhed don ma nor bar// mdor bsdus rab gsal bris pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun smra ba'i nyi ma grub gyur cig /ces pa gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ma nor rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po la brten pa'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams len zla ba'i zil mngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal ldan 'jam dpal rdo rje stobs bcu pa'i// phrin las rjes su skyong phyir srid gsum gyi// dregs byed yongs kyi ded dpon zlos gar mkhan// bla ma ma hā kā las rtag tu skyongs// rnal 'byor dbang mo dgyes pa'i lha yul nas// lo chen skal ldan shing rtas legs drangs pa// dus min 'chi ba'i sgrib sbyong mtho ris klung*// zab don bdud rtsi 'gyed la gnang ba stsol// grub dbang zhal lung byin rlabs ljing po che// brtson chung bus pa'i khur du ma 'tsham par// nyung 'dus stegs la ngal gsor spyod 'dod pas// nyams len zla ba'i zil mngar 'di 'thungs shig /'dir ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas gnyan lo tsā ba la rjes su gdams pa'i/ zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po la brten nas tshe sgrub thun mong ma yin pa nyams su bstar ba 'dod pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/

de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ chos kun 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings// khaṃ las lcags khang gru gsum nang*// me rlung 'bar klod nṛ tri kri// yongs su gyur pa'i nyam thag gzugs// dgra bgegs kun 'dus ngo bor gyur// steng nas yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ las// rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor ni// rim brtsegs stong gsum mnyam pas mnan// de steng phyi nas nang rim bzhin// rlung gi gur khang g.yo zhing 'tshub// me yi gur khang tsha zhing rtsub// rak+ta'i gur khang dba' rlangs 'khrugs// mtshon cha'i gur khang rtse phyir phyogs// sde brgyad gur khang me'i rang bzhin// zhing skyong gur khang me ri 'bar// yum chen bzhi yi gur khang ni// lcags mkhar gru bzhi zur phyogs bstan// de nang bh+rūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo khong stong rtsibs drug pa// rtsibs dbus pad nyi'i gdan bcas gyur// dbus su hūm̐ mthing 'phro 'du las// bdag nyid rdo rje gur mgon ni// gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍī yis// phyag char spras pa'i 'jigs rungs sku// zlum po'i stabs bzhugs mgo phreng sogs// rgyan rdzogs me 'bar klong na brjid// rtsibs drug gdan la hūm̐ byung gi /gri gug hūm̐ mtshan las skyes pa'i// nag po chen po gdong bzhi ldan// rtsa zhal brtsegs mthing lhag ma gnyis// ljang nag 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams// phyag bzhi gri gug thod khrag dang*// ral gri rus phreng 'phyar thabs 'dzin// dar dang rin chen sbrul rus brgyan// me klong g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs// phyi rol yum chen gur khang gi /phyogs kyi grwa bzhir hūm̐ bzhi las// g.yas g.yon g.yung mo gtum mo gnyis// mdun rgyab srin mo siṅga li// rang mdog gri gug thod pas brel// gcer mo skra grol 'dzum zhing sgeg /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis bzhengs// zhing skyong gur du zhing skyong brgyad// zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sdes bskor// sde brgyad gur du snang srid kyi// lha srin sde brgyad rang gzugs kyis// nang bltas srung ba'i bsam pas 'khod// bdag gi snying gar gzhal med khang*// pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang ldan dbus// bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje sngo// sa gnon mnyam gzhag phyag rgya dang*// rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa yi// thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi// nang dang phyi rol 'dab ma bzhir// hrīḥlnga las byung bcom ldan 'das// tshe dpag med lnga sku mdog dmar// mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe'i// bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa 'dzin// sna tshogs rgyan mdzes skyil krung bsnol// gtso bo rgyal pa'i thugs kar yang*// nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor nang*// rang sems hrīḥyig dmar por gsal// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// sa bon 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas// rang 'dra rten dang brten par bcas// tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrigs lnga yang*// tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// de bzhin gshegs kun bdag dbang bskur// des kyang oṃ badz+rī bha wa// a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dang chus// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag

/tshe dpag med la 'od dpag med// bla ma gur mgon mi bskyod pa// gzhan spyir rdo rje phyed pas brgyan// da nas bzlas pa bya ba ni// snying ga'i hrīḥmathar bsrung bya dang*// bzlas bya'i sngags bkod 'od zer gyis// 'khor 'das tshe dpal bsod nams bsdu// res 'ga' tshe yi lha mo spros// srid gsum sems can 'jig rten skyong*// kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams bcud// bum par bsdus nas dbang bskur bas// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob// ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ oṃ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥbh+rūm̐/ bin+dha bin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tshe bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ khug bin+dha bh+rūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ/ puṇ+ya puṇ+ya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs bzlas mthar/ rlung bum pa can tshar gsum tsam bzung*/ de nas bsrung ba'i don du/ lha tshogs zhal dang 'khor lo las// sngags kyi sgra dbyangs 'brug ltar ldir// snying ga'i sngags las me dpung 'phros// phyi nang bar chad srung byed cing*// phyi rol rlung dang 'dres gyur pas// srid gsum dgra bgegs bsregs shing gtor// zhes pa'i don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ḍom+bi nī bdag la srung shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ de bzhin du/ tsan+d+ra lī/ rak+kha sī/ siṅga lī/ oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa tsaṭ+ṭe swa hūm̐/ sa i yaṃ/ sa ka ra la ti yaṃ/ sa hu baṃ/ gh+ri ta kī li kī la ya/ bhi bhi ṣa na pa ta ye na maḥsrungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes pa rnams ci nus bzla/ spro na sngags ring gi mthar yang spel tshig gong bzhin btags pa'ang bzlas mthar/ su gang dag sogs kyis dmod pa dor la thal mo lan gsum brdab bo// thun las ldang ba na/ khams gsum 'od zhu srung 'khor thim// de dag rim zhu bdag la thim// zhes brjod cing bsams/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i// tshe srog rdo rje ltar brtan pas// byang chub lam mthar phyin par shog

/lo brgya thub cing sogs brjod do// de ltar nyams su blangs pas tshe 'dir tshe ring zhing bar chad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ba ni gdams pa 'di'i zab khyad yin par bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa las shes par bya'o// smras pa/ rjod byed nyung ngu zhig tu rgyas don kyang*// tshang ba 'di 'dra sngon chad ma dran zhes// 'gyod pas mes po gnyid la ma yur ba'i// ngo tsha mig mi 'dzums pa'i zol gyis bsgribs// rnam dkar legs byas ma la ya rlung gis// dus min 'chi ba'i tsha gdung yongs bcil nas// thos bsam bsgom pa'i gom stabs stong bsgyur bas// don gnyis grub pa'i grong khyer phyin gyur cig /ces zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po la brten pa'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams len zla ba'i zil mngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nyer gnas kun dga' bsam gtan gyis rgyun du gdon byar tshigs su bcad pa nyung 'dus shig dgos zhes gleng 'phral/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge bklag pas don grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas 'byung ba'i so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la praṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab sngo ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su praṃ ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad so sor 'brang ma chen po'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim/ slar yang praṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du praṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re

rdor phreng dang rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba la ni bar 'dir hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bzhi lhag po yod/ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /so so'i 'brang ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na dge ba bsngo ba'i gong der dkar gtor zlum po bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti ma hā pra ti sā re oṃ a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags de sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod byas nas gsol ba btab rjes/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gtor mgron rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs la rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o// rjes gnang byed na/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du dkar gtor zlum po dang nyer spyod kyis bskor ba spyi ltar bsham/ slob dpon gyi bya ba mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag bskyed gdan bsdu ba'i bar gong ltar dang mdun bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/

mtshan sngags/ oṃ bha ga wa ti ma hā pra ti sā re sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa rnams spyi ltar bya'o// slob ma la bya bar sems bskyed gsal gdab cing maṇ+ḍal phul nas dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyun bshags bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams lan gsum gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug dngos gzhi la slob ma lhar bskyed cing rang 'dra bstim pa dang*/ rjes su bzlas pa dang dam bca' ba dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gsum gyi sgo nas sbyin/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis khas blang ba/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ deng nas brtsams te sogs sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// mchod pa kha gsos te rjes kyi mchod bstod dang tshom bu'i lha gshegs bsdu dang bkra shis kyi bar spyi ltar bya'o// zhes so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge bklag pas don grub ces pa 'di ni/ srib dgon dbon po'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// gu ru drag po mnga' bdag lugs kyi las byang pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lha// pad+ma drag po la btud de// de yi las byang 'khyer bde yi// pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan bstar// gu ru drag po mnga' bdag nyang*// lugs kyi bsgom bzlas bya ba la// thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni// sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun gyi dngos// bla ma pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas bsgrub// lan gsum/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings// rdo rje'i gur khang yangs pa'i nang*// bh+rūm̐ las drag po thod pa'i mkhar// phyi nang me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus// pad+ma nyi zla srin po ror// hūm̐ las skyes pa'i bdag mdun lha// gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// sku mdog dmar po me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas gnod byed gdug pa can// tshar gcod rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas gdon bgegs 'byung po'i snying*// 'byin pa'i lcags sdig mgo dgu 'dzin// rab khros dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// me dpung klong na brkyang bskum bzhengs// spyi gtsug bya khyung mthing nag dang*// rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs// dpral bar 'jam dpal oṃ gyis mtshan// mgrin par rta mgrin āḥyis mtshan// thugs kar phyag rdor hūm̐ gis mtshan// sprul pa yak+sha me dbal 'phros// stong gsum gnod byed tshar bcad gyur// ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/

hūm̐ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs rnams// dregs pa 'dul phyir da tshur gshegs// bdag mdun lha dang dbyer med gyur// mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros mchod gtor rnams// bsregs sbyangs bkrus nas byin gyis brlabs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta'i mtsho// me tog spos sogs mchod pa'i sprin// gu ru drag po'i tshogs la 'bul// bdud rtsi rak+ta pi ba tha// i daṃ ba liṃ kha khā hi// sarba pū dza so sor bzhes// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bskal pa snyigs ma'i sems can la// byin rlabs thugs rje ches myur ba// lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba po// che mchog drag po'i tshogs la bstod// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ phyag rdor thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar// sngags phreng bkod pa'i 'od zer gyis// nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs shing sbyangs// gu ru'i byin rlabs rang la bsdus// oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus/ sde brgyad srog sngags/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ yak+sha hūm̐/ rak+sha hūm̐/ gnod byed gdon bgegs rgyal 'gong ba srin mo dam sri'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa sham bu'i sngags so// bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag dang sems can gyi// nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*// dngos grub thams cad thob pa ni// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes 'dod don gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya/ rig 'dzin nang sgrub zab chos 'di// bgyis pa'i dge bas sems can kun// dregs pa'i sde tshogs dbang 'dus nas// zab mo'i lam gyis grol gyur cig

/gu ru drag po mnga' bdag nyang ral lugs kyi las byang pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ sde dge sa skyong bla ma'i mdun na 'don blo gros brtan pa'i zhal 'don du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter// pad+ma 'byung gnas rnam 'phrul mnga' bdag nyang*// mnga' bdag sras chung gu ru chos rin chen// chos nyid rang grol rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas lhun dbang kun dga' bkra shis pa// rgyal sras chos rje sngags 'chang legs pa dpal// shes rab rgyal mtshan sa lo thams cad mkhyen// kun dga' rin chen rnams la= /bsod nams dbang po nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// bstan 'dzin lhun grub dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= yang na/ bsod nams dbang po bsod nams lhun gyis grub// lhun grub dpal ldan kun dga' bkra shis zhabs// kun dga' bsod nams rin chen chos grags mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /zhes gang mos brjod mthar/ dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang dbyer med pa'i// pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas// byang chub bar du bsrung zhing bskyang du gsol// gnas skabs sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi// lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi min gyis// sdang dang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun spangs nas// byams pa'i sems kyis bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig ltung kun sbyangs nas// sgo gsum pad+ma thod phreng drag po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer legs bsgrubs nas// bstan 'gror phan bde 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// snyigs ma'i rang stobs bdo ba'i gnas skabs 'dir// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen rgud pa rnams// nyi 'od dang phrad mun pa ltar zhi nas// mthun rkyen dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar mdzod// ces gu ru drag po nyang lugs kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'dod don kun stsol zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
